So one strategic result of the Iran war will be lessening economic leverage on both Russia and Iran.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

As EU vote approaches on U.S. trade deal, EU MP @brandobenifei tells me: “I want to be very clear: threats coming from the other side of the Atlantic will not help Europe, but also will not help US interests. We need to be on good terms for our economy to work well together. We should stop hearing threats one time on Spain, one time on Greenland, one time on France. This is not useful for the American economy.”

His answer regarding the violent attack on the senator: “I did not say I support it. I said I understood it.”


Senator Rand Paul (@SenRandPaul)

"So, today, Markwayne Mullin, I’ll give you a chance. Tell it to my face. Tell the world why you believe I deserved to be assaulted from behind, have six ribs broken, and a damaged lung. Tell me to my face why you think I deserved it."

Video
